opportunities.title: Main Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be based in the UK with formal employment or contractual relationship with a UK host institution; excludes individuals without UK institution, undergraduates, PhD fees, schools, local charities, and projects led by organisations not based in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's priority questions, offering up to £500,000 (special cases up to £750,000).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly racially minoritised communities and UK‑based organisations; partnership applications are welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, addressing inter‑generational changes and challenges, with grants of £15,000–£500,000.
